caption: The drawing depicts a decorative hair comb or ornamental pin, primarily colored in shades of gold and brown with accents of white and gray. The main body of the object is a curved, rectangular bar with two long, pointed prongs extending downwards, suggesting its function as a hair accessory. Along the top edge, there is a round floral motif with white and light blue petals encircling a gold center, bordered by gold detailing. To the right of the flower, a gold feather-shaped element is positioned horizontally. Two gold chains hang from the left side of the comb and are attached to pointed, drop-shaped pendants with gold spheres at their ends. The overall composition appears centered on a plain, light beige background.
title: Comb
